tonight.headline: You beat the unbeaten by 2.24
body: Bad news first. Woody Marks left with a concussion and Houston play Thursday. The Zvada-for-Gay kicker swap lost 2 to 8 and closes WRONG. Golden, Jacobs and the Rams D/ST are all on bye in Week 11, and Garrett Wilson's quarterback is in doubt (Geno Smith head/ankle; Klubnik may start).
The game is over on both sides: 136.26 to 134.02 over a 9-0 team, pending stat corrections. Maye-day started Drake Maye (2.5) with Mahomes' 34.9 on their bench. You are 3-7. Nothing to set.

case.label: How it was won
case.body: Likely 27.7 and Tuten 20.3 carried it; Maye-day lost the game in their own QB slot.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A stat correction worth more than 2.24 points before ESPN finalises the week.

whatWentWrong.title: Marks is in the protocol, on a short week
whatWentWrong.lead: Concussion in the third quarter; Houston play Indianapolis on Thursday.

case.label: What happened
case.body: 12 carries for 50 yards, then ruled out with a concussion (PFT 15 Nov). Demercado led the backfield after (NBC 15 Nov). An injury exit — not graded as a performance.

case.label: What it means
case.body: Your Week 11 backs are Taylor, Tuten and Gordon either way. Marks' open thesis turns on Montgomery: the 40%-of-carries clause is live when he returns.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Marks cleared by Wednesday with Montgomery still out.

whatWentWrong.title: The kicker swap lost — and Gay is on waivers
whatWentWrong.lead: Zvada 2, Gay 8. Do not reclaim Gay with priority that never resets.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Zvada was added on a 10.7-to-8.3 projection that fell to 8.1 by kickoff; Thursday he scored 2, Gay 8 (archive).

case.label: The rule it bent
case.body: STRATEGY §5: a stream needs a real gap; 2.4 projected points on a kicker was marginal.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing — closed WRONG. Next kicker move only for a free agent with a real gap.

roster.footnote: Both sides are final. Result column: actuals and the gap to projection. Matchup tiles were not researched this run — the week is over. Odunze (bye) shows 0.0; Jacobs was out.
